title: Compact derived objects are retracts of finite generator complexes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof first obtains a bounded retract via truncation homotopy colimits, then inductively shrinks each infinite sum using compactness and homological lifting through a distinguished triangle. This finite reconstruction argument is a substantial compact-generation theorem.
